ava: Hey team — PR #412 ready for docs review: migration guide for Dedicated -> Private v0.2. Main changes: network section, examples for SDK v1.3, snippet for env var config. PTAL. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412

liam: taking a look now. quick q: do we still prefer 'Redwood Private' capitalization in headings? (noticed 'private deployment' in the title)

maria: yes — style guide says 'Redwood Private' for product names. Also prefer active voice and no 'we' in user-facing steps. I'll flag exact phrasing.

sre-ci: docs preview | PR #412 — FAIL
- Link check: 1 dead link (internal) /preview/paths -> 404
- Markdownlint: warning line 123 (heading style)
preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr/412

ava: thanks — I think the broken link is in the network diagram anchor. I'll push a quick fix.

ava: (push) fix: replace /preview/paths with /reference/networking#paths

sre-ci: docs preview | PR #412 — RUNNING

docs-bot: Note: Two reviewers required for merge per CODEOWNERS: @maria, @chen

liam: small SDK snippet nit: prefer triple-backtick python and named params. Current snippet:
```python
client = RedwoodClient('token')
client.run('model', 'prompt')
```
should be:
```python
client = RedwoodClient(api_key='${REDWOOD_API_KEY}')
client.generate(model='redwood-2-mini', prompt='...')
```

maria: 👍 thanks — that aligns with snippets in /guides/sdk-patterns. also change 'model name' examples to the canonical short tags.

ava: done — updated snippet and wording. pushed 1767895001

sre-ci: docs preview | PR #412 — SUCCESS
preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr/412

maria: I'm happy with wording and tone. left one small suggestion inline about 'latency SLOs' -> 'latency targets' for audience clarity.

liam: I approved. @maria still needs to approve per CODEOWNERS.

maria: approved. merging after 2pm PT to avoid interfering with morning deploys. please schedule merge window.

ava: will merge at 14:05 PT and set a small canary flag. thx all :tada:

chen: noted — if any rollout issues, ping #eng-oncall

ava: merged at 14:05 PT — sha abc1234. Closing thread.
